notes:
Short summary: Lost to direct OpenAI/Anthropic APIs — customer repeatedly cited ease-of-use + brand familiarity + existing partner discounts. POC performed fine technically but procurement drove consolidation decision. Key fragments from calls:
- 'We like Redwood's telemetry but we already have credits and simpler billing with OpenAI.'
- InfoSec flagged data residency as negotiable, asked for attestation; timeline slipped.
- No concrete executive sponsor after Q4 reorg — champion (Head of Search), promoted out of org mid-POC.
POC details: embeddings index (100k product descriptions), reranking pipeline for search, conversational support bot for returns. Latency target 150ms p95 on search rerank; Redwood demo hit ~180ms in burst tests but stable under steady-state. Customer cost sensitivity: wants sub-$0.0008/token for high volume embedding ingestion; flagged Redwood pricing as higher when factoring dedicated overhead.
Sales notes / deal hygiene: Pricing deck version 3 sent (drive link). Multiple threads with procurement — final procurement email (thread-2026-01-29-poc-reply) asked for single-vendor SLA and consolidated invoice, which Redwood could not match because customer wanted OpenAI bulk discounts + enterprise contract.
Next recommended internal actions: log lost-reason tags (brand_preference, procurement_consolidation), save POC artifacts for future re-open, follow up in 6-8 months for re-eval when internal champions stabilize.
Contact cadence: do not proactive outreach for 3 months; allow SE/AE to re-engage only if customer requests benchmarking or price flexibility.
